summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of commas within regular expressions being incorrectly interpreted as delimiters. It introduces logic to handle nested brackets, which is a reasonable approach.

issues.description: The patch assumes that all opening brackets increase the bracket count and all closing brackets decrease it, which may not cover all edge cases such as escaped brackets or different types of brackets mixed together.
The logic could be made more readable by using a stack to manage bracket levels instead of a simple counter.
